description: Reviewed seed candidates for connecting semantic pressure structures to unit-total active shapes. This packet is training pressure only and is not wired into the default combiner until browser tests and review-gate checks pass.

entries.text: A semantic pressure vector can be projected into a unit-total active shape when its absolute dimensions are normalized to one.
entries.literal_meaning: A semantic vector can be represented as an active shape whose absolute dimensions sum to one.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: Semantic pressure structures can become objective-language shape candidates only after normalization preserves Σ|dimension_i| = 1.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Projection is legitimate only when the resulting active shape has root L1 and flattened L1 equal to one.

evidence_burden: Normalize the absolute dimension total to one.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: treat the projection as a unit-total structure candidate
expected_kernel_response.source_trust_action: use the projection as training pressure only after review checks pass
questions: Does the projected shape preserve Σ|dimension_i| = 1?

entries.text: The same active shape should keep its anonymous structure when local pressure labels are renamed.
entries.literal_meaning: Renaming local labels should not change the anonymous structure of a valid active shape.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: Objective-language candidates must be label-invariant: labels are metadata, while the reusable object is the structure that survives renaming.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: The anonymous shape signature must remain stable after local labels are renamed.

evidence_burden: Check that the anonymous signature is unchanged.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: separate structure from local label names
expected_kernel_response.source_trust_action: treat label-stable structure as a stronger candidate than label-dependent structure
questions: Does the anonymous structure survive label renaming?

entries.text: A repeated anonymous shape signature is a reusable structure candidate, not a truth decision.
entries.literal_meaning: Repeated anonymous signatures can identify reusable structure but do not decide whether a claim is true.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel may use repeated anonymous shape signatures as training pressure for structure discovery while preserving zero belief movement from repetition alone.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Repetition is legitimate structure pressure only when the signature repeats across reviewed observations and does not collapse distinct roles.

evidence_burden: Group observations by anonymous shape signature.
Require repeated observations before review acceptance.
Do not infer truth from repeated structure alone.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: treat repetition as reusable structure pressure
expected_kernel_response.source_trust_action: hold as a reviewed structure candidate rather than doctrine
questions: Does the repeated anonymous signature preserve role boundaries, or is it over-broad?

entries.text: Shape describes the normalized active structure, while force describes intensity applied through that structure.
entries.literal_meaning: The shape and the force are separate: the shape sums to one, and magnitude is applied afterward.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: The kernel should not confuse more dimensions, stronger language, or repeated structure with greater force; force is modeled separately as F = M · i.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Force may be applied only after the active shape is normalized; intensity does not change the shape total.

evidence_burden: Verify the active shape has L1 total one.
Identify the magnitude term M separately.
Apply force as F = M · i.
Do not treat force as extra shape mass.

expected_kernel_response.source_trust_action: block interpretations that inflate active shape beyond one
questions: Is this change refining the shape, or changing the force applied through the shape?
